theater: 撒馬爾罕—布哈拉—花剌子模戰線

battle.name: 888年薩曼尼德內戰
battle.theater: 撒馬爾罕—布哈拉—花剌子模戰線
battle.brief: 八八八年，薩曼王朝兩位兄弟為瓜分家產再起干戈：坐鎮撒馬爾罕的納斯爾一世與坐鎮布哈拉、兼領花剌子模的伊斯馬伊爾一世開戰。卡面這具羅馬扭力弩砲本身不會出現在九世紀，但它同一血統的後裔——阿拔斯語所稱的 arrada 擲石機——正是薩曼投射隊列的骨幹。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這場衝突是薩曼王朝的家內之戰，交戰雙方是同父的兩位王族兄弟與各自掌握的王朝軍政機器，而不是兩個國家之間的戰爭。兄長納斯爾一世是薩曼全境的埃米爾，以撒馬爾罕為中樞，握著河中地區的常備軍隊與串連河中、呼羅珊的驛站體系；弟伊斯馬伊爾一世坐鎮布哈拉，並兼領錫爾河下游的花剌子模，把維齊爾府與首都禁軍抓在自己手裡。兩邊的兵源本質相同：薩曼王朝以突厥奴隸出身的將兵（ghilman）及其受田之後形成的軍事世家為骨幹，輔以伊朗系的迪赫坎騎兵、阿拉伯—呼羅珊的步兵與弓箭手，攻城時再臨時徵發工匠，並臨時配給糧秣。邊防體系也共用一套：撒馬爾罕、布哈拉、烏什魯薩納、卡特、法拉布一線的 ribat 要塞，加上呼羅珊方面的尼沙普爾、梅爾夫、穆爾甘與巴爾赫駐軍，構成從鹽漠到山地的驛遞與糧秣網絡。雙方都要維持對巴格達阿拔斯哈里發的宗藩禮儀，以在當地確認哈里發名義來合法化自己的名分，這一點也讓內戰始終帶著家事的色彩。戰線因此大致沿撒馬爾罕—布哈拉—花剌子模的三角反覆拉鋸。
countriesEn: This was a war inside the Samanid house: the two sides were two brothers of the same father and the two halves of the dynasty's own military and administrative machine, not two states. The elder, Nasr I, was amir of all the Samanid territories and sat at Samarkand, holding the standing armies of the river lands and the relay of posts that strung Khurasan onto Transoxiana. The younger, Ismail I, sat in Bukhara and also held Khwarazm below the Syr Darya, keeping the vizier's office and the capital's garrison in his own hands. The manpower on both sides was essentially the same. The backbone of the Samanid army was the ghilman, the Turkish slave soldiers and the military households that grew out of them once they were granted land, supported by the Iranian dihqani cavalry and by Arab-Khurasani infantry and archers; engineers were levied for the duration of a siege and rations were issued for it. The frontier network was likewise shared: the ribat strongholds along Samarkand, Bukhara, Ushrusana, Kath, Farab and the Batin shore, together with the garrisons of Nishapur, Merv, Murghan and Balkh in Khurasan, formed the network of relays and supply that ran from the salt desert into the mountains. Both brothers also had to keep up the vassal protocol of the Abbasid caliph in Baghdad, giving the caliph's name in the Friday sermon to legitimize their own claim, and that too gave the war its character of family business. The front therefore opened and closed along the Samarkand-Bukhara-Khwarazm triangle.
people: 可以確定的交涉人物主要就是薩曼家的兩兄弟。納斯爾一世，即穆罕默德·伊本·伊斯馬伊爾，以薩曼全境埃米爾之名坐鎮撒馬爾罕，是這場內戰中被挑戰的一方；伊斯馬伊爾一世是布哈拉與花剌子模的統治者，是發動進攻並取得決定性勝利的一方。雙方陣中將領的姓名在殘存記載裏多已散佚，可以確定的只是職位：納斯爾一方有掌璽的維齊爾，伊斯馬伊爾一方有布哈拉總督與花剌子模總督，另有掌管軍械與攻城器械的將官隨軍作戰。地方綠洲首領與受封的迪赫坎貴族在兩邊之間反覆改換歸附，是決定戰局的關鍵人物；其中一部分人直接倒向伊斯馬伊爾，這也是此役不需曠日持久便見分曉的主因。傳說中，勝出的弟弟在勝利之後仍向兄長表示歉意，甚至俯身親吻兄長之手，兩兄弟維持了表面的家族禮數。巴格達的阿拔斯哈里發不是交戰方，卻是雙方都要爭取的合法性來源，在位者當時是穆爾塔米德，其後接替的是穆塔迪德；薩曼家的任何一位王族都必須以哈里發在東方的代表自居，內戰一旦公開化，等於向外界宣告王朝的裂痕。至於後世的編年史家如蘇萊與伊本·赫勒敦，正是從這類家族醜聞與王朝片段中提煉出對薩曼興衰的評述。
peopleEn: The persons whose role can be established are above all the two brothers of the house. Nasr I, that is Muhammad ibn Isma'il, sat at Samarkand as amir of all the Samanid territories and was the challenged party in this civil war. Ismail I, ruler of Bukhara and Khwarazm, was the party that opened the war and took the decisive victory. The names of the commanders on both sides have mostly been lost in the surviving record; what can be established are the offices. On Nasr's side there was the vizier who kept the seal, and on Ismail's side there were the governor of Bukhara and the governor of Khwarazm, together with the officer in charge of the armory and of the siege engines, who went with the army. The chiefs of the oasis towns and the enfeoffed dihqani nobles switched their allegiance back and forth between the two brothers, and they were the people who decided the war. A number of them went over to Ismail outright, which is the main reason the business did not drag on for months. Legend has it that the victorious brother still showed his brother remorse after the victory, even bending to kiss his hand, so that the two kept the outward forms of family courtesy. The Abbasid caliph in Baghdad was not a belligerent, but he was the source of legitimacy both sides fought for; the caliph then in office was al-Mu'tamid, followed by al-Mu'tadid. Any member of the Samanid house had to present himself as the caliph's representative in the East, and a civil war that broke into the open amounted to announcing the fracture of the dynasty to the world outside. Later chroniclers such as al-Suli and Ibn Khaldun are precisely the men who distilled judgements on the rise and fall of the Samanids out of this kind of family scandal and these dynastic fragments.
kits: 卡面這具羅馬弩砲（Scorpio）是一件扭力式的單發弩機，羅馬人用它拆掉希臘的城牆。它不會以羅馬原型的樣式出現在八八年的戰場上，但同一技術族系在伊斯蘭世界另有後裔：阿拔斯語稱 arrada 的射矢與擲石扭力機、波斯語稱 zarad（亦作 zaghāz）的攻城機，以及配重式的 manjaniq，都是從晚期古代與拜占庭的技術譜系一路傳入的東西，在九世紀已是薩曼軍械庫的標準配備。內戰期間，投射機是決定攻城與野戰走向的骨幹：arrada 負責壓制城頭、掩護步卒前推，配重投石機拋擲石塊砸擊城牆與屋頂，當時的圍城記述裏還有噴射火油與油的管嘴（naffatun）。步兵裝備方面，薩曼軍用反曲的複合弓、長標槍，以及刀身漸成直脊的雙刃彎刀，後者正是往後幾個世紀被稱為伊斯蘭之劍的祖型；護具沿用薩珊傳統的札甲與鎖子甲（dir），馬匹以阿拉伯種與土庫曼種為主，騎兵的重要裝備還包括馬鐙與馬甲。攻城另需撞錘、蒙皮製成的攻城塔、雲梯與用於填壕的土筐與沙袋；交通與糧秣靠駱駝隊、牛車與沿岸的糧倉維持。開礦與鑄造屬於工匠行會的事，史料不載其細節，本站亦不作推想。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card, the Roman Scorpio, is a single-shot torsion engine, and the Romans used it to break down Greek city walls. It would not appear on an eighth-century battlefield in its Roman form, but the same technical family had descendants in the Islamic world: the arrada, a torsion engine shooting bolts and stones in Arabic, the zarad of Persian (also written zaghāz), and the counterweight manjaniq all came down the technical line that runs from late antiquity and Byzantium, and by the ninth century they were standard issue in the Samanid armory. During the civil war the artillery was the backbone that decided both siege and field work. The arrada was used to silence the walls and cover the advance of the infantry; the counterweight machines threw stone at walls and roofs; and the siege narratives of the period also mention pipes that spouted naphtha and oil, the naffatun. On the infantry side the Samanid troops carried recurved composite bows, long spears, and the double-edged sabre whose blade was becoming straight-backed, the ancestor of what later centuries would call the sword of Islam. Armour followed the Sasanian tradition of lamellar and mail, the dir; the horses were mostly of Arab and Turkoman stock, and the cavalryman also relied on saddle, stirrup and horse-armour. Siege work needed rams, hides-covered siege towers, ladders, and wicker baskets and sandbags for filling the ditch; movement and supply were kept up by camel caravans, ox carts and depots along the road. Mining and casting were the business of the guilds of craftsmen, the sources record no detail of them, and this site offers no conjecture in their place.
tactics: 內戰的作戰方式與對外戰役相差不遠：目標是控制綠洲城邑、水源與驛站，而不是爭奪開闊地。攻方通常以騎兵遮斷城郊道路、在鹽漠邊緣切斷糧車隊伍，再把步兵與投射機拖到射程所及的位置；arrada 先以遠程射擊削弱城頭，配重投石機隨後把石塊擲向城牆與民居，壕溝以土筐與沙袋填平，攻城塔才在掩護下推近牆根。防守方多以 ribat 的石造堡壘固守，閉城不出，等援軍到來或等對手因糧秣耗盡而退兵。騎兵在河中與花剌子模之間的大平原上展開追擊，試圖切斷對方的退路與徵發地，錫爾河渡口與阿姆河下游的橋樑是兵家必爭的點。由於兩軍的將兵多出自同一批受田的軍事世家，倒戈往往比正面會戰更快決定勝負；一旦某位總督帶著駐軍轉投對方，那座城與它周圍的稅源、糧源便整片易手。薩曼王朝的投射機在編制上似乎另有專門的器械部隊隨埃米爾調度，攻城器械與野戰部隊之間的調配，是這場戰爭中最能看出後勤分量的一環。
tacticsEn: The way this civil war was fought differed little from a foreign campaign: the object was to control the oasis towns, the water and the post stations, not to win ground in the open. The attacker would usually cover the roads around the town with cavalry, cut the supply carts off at the edge of the salt desert, and then drag the infantry and the artillery up to the range of the engines. The arrada opened by weakening the walls at long distance, the counterweight machines followed by throwing stone at walls and roofs, the ditch was filled with baskets and sandbags, and only then were the siege towers pushed up to the wall under cover. The defenders generally held fast in the stone forts of the ribat, kept the gates shut and waited either for relief or for the enemy to run out of rations and withdraw. The cavalry ran its pursuits across the great plain between the river lands and Khwarazm, trying to cut the enemy's retreat and its recruiting grounds; the crossings of the Syr Darya and the bridges below the Amu Darya were the points every commander wanted. Since the soldiers on both sides came largely from the same land-granted military households, defection usually decided the outcome faster than a pitched battle did. Once a governor turned over with his garrison, the city and the taxes and provisions around it changed hands entire. The Samanids seem to have kept the artillery in a separate establishment of engines that was moved about with the amir himself, and the shifting of siege equipment between siege and field work is the part of this war in which the weight of logistics shows most plainly.
data: 可以落實的數字不多，先說年份與地界。內戰發生於八八八年，即回曆二七六年前後；它緊接著八八五年那場以維持原狀收場的內戰，兩場相隔約三年。史料只記年份，不載月日，本站以回曆二七六年起始之時（西曆八八八年年中）標月，並註明這是推定。疆界方面，薩曼王朝東至阿姆河與興都庫什山，西抵咸海與裏海之間的花剌子模低地，呼羅珊方面包括尼沙普爾、梅爾夫、穆爾甘與巴爾赫。兩位主角的距離：撒馬爾罕與布哈拉相隔約二百五十公里，兩地之間有驛站串連；布哈拉到花剌子模約五百公里，沿錫爾河南岸的鹽漠邊緣行軍要穿越無人地帶，這條補給線是花剌子模一方的弱點。兵員方面，薩曼的野戰軍以萬計的騎兵為主，首都禁軍則是數千之譜；至於這場內戰具體投入的人數、攻城器械的數目與損失數字，現存記載都沒有留下可信的數字，本站不予推算，也不把後人書中的概數當作實數。
dataEn: Few numbers can be pinned down, so begin with the date and the geography. The civil war broke out in the year 888, that is around AH 276; it came immediately after the civil war of 885 that had ended in a return to the status quo, the two being roughly three years apart. The sources give the year only, with no month or day, so this site dates the campaign to the opening of AH 276, that is the middle of the year 888 in the Gregorian calendar, and marks that dating as an inference. As for the frontiers, the Samanid state ran from the Amu Darya and the Hindu Kush in the east to the Khwarazm lowland between the Caspian and the Aral in the west, and in Khurasan it held Nishapur, Merv, Murghan and Balkh. The distance between the two principals of the war: Samarkand and Bukhara lie about 250 kilometres apart, with post stations strung between them; from Bukhara to Khwarazm it is roughly 500 kilometres, and an army marching along the southern edge of the Syr Darya through the salt desert had to cross a stretch of uninhabited country, which made that supply line the weak point of the Khwarazm side. On troops, the Samanid field army was in the tens of thousands of riders, while the capital garrison was on the order of a few thousand men. As for the numbers actually committed in this civil war, the men, the number of siege engines, and the losses, the surviving record preserves no figures that can be trusted; this site does not compute them, and does not pass off the round numbers of later books as fact.
cause: 薩曼家族的開國者伊斯馬伊爾·薩馬尼把土地與權柄分派給兒子們，卻沒有留下一套可以自動解決繼承的規則：河中的核心由誰坐鎮、呼羅珊與花剌子模歸誰調度，都變成兄弟之間各自都能辯護的權利主張。八八五年那場內戰把這條界線打成模糊，兩邊各有損失卻誰也沒有取得決定性優勢；到八八八年，爭執再起，形式上仍是兄弟之間的家務，內容卻已經是對王朝整體權力與資源分配的控制。導火索是兩位兄弟在都城與邊區之間的部署互相滲透：布哈拉一側把手伸向撒馬爾罕的駐軍與鹽漠邊的 ribat，撒馬爾罕一側則試圖重新確認自己對花剌子模的宗主權。此外，巴格達的宗藩體制使任何一位薩曼王族都必須自稱哈里發在當地的代表，內戰一旦公開化，等於向外界宣告薩曼王朝內部的裂痕；這正是雙方都把衝突限制在王朝內部、以家務的名義收束的原因。
causeEn: The founder of the house, Isma'il Samani, distributed lands and authority among his sons but left behind no rule that would settle a succession by itself. Who should sit in the heart of the river lands, who should direct Khurasan and Khwarazm, became claims of right that each brother could argue in his own turn. The civil war of 885 left that line blurred: both sides had suffered and neither had gained a decisive advantage. By 888 the quarrel was alive again, formally still the business of the family, but in substance already a struggle for the control of the dynasty's power and its resources as a whole. The spark was the two brothers reaching into each other's deployments in the capitals and on the frontier: the Bukhara side extended its hand towards the Samarkand garrisons and towards the ribats on the edge of the salt desert, while the Samarkand side tried to reassert its overlordship over Khwarazm. In addition, the vassal order centred on Baghdad obliged every Samanid prince to present himself as the caliph's representative in that land, and a civil war that came into the open amounted to announcing the fracture inside the Samanid dynasty to the world. That is why both brothers kept the fighting inside the dynasty and closed it under the name of family business.
impact: 這場內戰的直接後果，是薩曼王朝的權力結構從兄弟分治轉為事實上的一人獨大：伊斯馬伊爾成為帝國的實際統治者，兄長失去大部分權力卻保住名位，據載並未被廢黜；兄長死後，他名正言順地接任埃米爾。值得注意的是，衝突並沒有改變薩曼王朝的制度本身——分封、軍人世家與中央和邊區之間的張力都原封不動，於是九世紀末至十世紀初又接連出現新的父子兄弟之爭，內戰成為王朝的常態。遠期看，這類消耗削弱了薩曼中央對花剌子模的控制：花剌子模的薩曼支系（十一世紀初建國的花剌子模王朝即出自這一支）逐步坐大，薩曼王朝在呼羅珊與河中的資源被自家內耗抽走，最終為加茲尼的崛起讓出空間。文化上，布哈拉作為波斯語文學與伊斯蘭學術中心的地位並未因這場戰事而中斷，在王朝集權之後反而更形集中；薩曼王朝以波斯人君主的身份替阿拔斯哈里發守護東方的這段政治史，也被後世的編年史家反覆引用。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the civil war was that the balance of power inside the Samanid dynasty shifted from a partition between brothers to a de facto rule by one man. Ismail became the actual ruler of the empire; the elder brother lost most of his power but kept his place, and was not deposed as far as the record goes, and after the elder's death Ismail succeeded to the title of amir in his own right. What matters is that the conflict changed nothing in the institutions themselves: the appanages, the military households, and the strain between the centre and the frontier all remained as they were, so that from the late ninth century into the tenth a fresh series of father-and-son and brother-and-brother quarrels broke out, and civil war became a habit of the dynasty. In the long run this kind of exhaustion loosened the Samanid centre's grip on Khwarazm. The Samanid line there, the stock from which the Khwarazmian dynasty of the early eleventh century came, grew steadily stronger on its own, while the Samanid state drained its resources in Khurasan and the river lands through its own fratricide, and so cleared the way for the Ghaznavids. On the cultural side the standing of Bukhara as a centre of Persian letters and Islamic scholarship was not broken by this war, and became more concentrated once the dynasty was centralized; the Samanid chapter, in which a Persian dynasty kept watch over the East for the Abbasid caliph, is quoted again and again by the later chroniclers.
result: 結局記載簡短而明確：八八八年的內戰以伊斯馬伊爾一世的決定性勝利告終，這一點與八八五年那場打成平手的內戰形成對照；納斯爾一世失去大部分權力，但仍在薩曼王朝的王位上，沒有被廢黜。勝者對敗者保留了家族禮數，傳說中伊斯馬伊爾甚至俯身親吻兄長之手以示歉意，此說出於後世敘述，真確與否難以核實。政治上，伊斯馬伊爾自此成為帝國的實際主人，兄長死後接任埃米爾之位，薩曼王朝進入由他主導的最後一段治世，直至十世紀末才被加茲尼王朝取代。戰役本身留下了什麼，仍須老實交代：現存專門記載只保存下交戰雙方、勝負與結果的骨架，戰場所在、交戰日期、雙方兵員、攻城器械的數目與傷亡數字都沒有被可靠地記下；本站只把可以確定的部分寫成史實，其餘一概不作推測。
resultEn: The outcome is recorded briefly and plainly. The civil war of 888 ended in a decisive victory for Ismail I, in contrast to the civil war of 885, which had ended in a draw. Nasr I lost most of his power but remained on the Samanid throne and was not deposed. The victor kept up the family courtesies toward the defeated: legend has it that Ismail bent and kissed his brother's hand in token of apology, a story that comes down from later narrators and cannot easily be verified. Politically Ismail was from that point the actual master of the empire, and after his brother's death he took the seat of amir, and the Samanid dynasty entered the last stretch of its government under him, lasting until the Ghaznavids replaced it at the end of the tenth century. What the battle itself left behind still has to be stated honestly: the surviving notice preserves only the skeleton of the affair, the two parties, the victor and the result. The place of the fighting, the dates, the numbers of men on each side, the count of siege engines and the losses were not reliably recorded; this site writes as history only what can be established, and guesses at nothing beyond it.
